notes.title: Lunar New Year 2023: Beginner's Guide
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/2138681f109a735dc77cdc25463579ac2f43f88c.jpg[/img]

The annual Lunar New Year festival is in full swing in Divinity's Reach! Tyrians are celebrating the beginning of the Year of the Rabbit with fireworks, games, delicious Canthan food, and prizes. This yearly festival is now live and will be available until January 31. You can check out all the details in the full release notes on our official forums.

This festival is accessible to players of any level. Even if you're brand new to the game, you can easily take part in our Lunar New Year activities and earn new cosmetic unlocks, utility items, and more! Read on for a quick rundown of the activities you can participate in during this festival and the rewards you can earn!

[h1]Rewards[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/97fcc618eddf5c173644da59d5fe6de2ca954eb8.jpg[/img]

Lunar New Year activities will reward you with Essences of Luck, items that can either be consumed to permanently increase your account's magic find attribute or be used as a currency at Lunar New Year festival vendors at the Crown Pavilion in Divinity's Reach. You'll also earn other currencies—such as the Token of the Celestial Champion from the Celestial Challenge—that can be exchanged for Lucky Envelopes.

Lucky Envelopes are containers that are affected by your account's magic find attribute. Increase your magic find for chances at better rewards when opening them. Lucky Envelopes can contain additional Essences of Luck, valuable trophies that you can sell to vendors for cash, and a chance at rare weapons, armor, and more. This year, every Lucky Envelope has a chance to grant you the Lucky Rabbit Lantern. Get that magic find up and open as many envelopes as you can!

Completing daily and annual achievements will allow you to earn new weapons, armor, and more! Check the Achievements pane in your Hero panel and navigate to the Daily Lunar New Year and Festivals sections for more information.

[h1]Where to Go[/h1]
The Crown Pavilion in Divinity's Reach is your hub for Lunar New Year festivities. Check your in-game mail for an Invitation to Lunar New Year and double-click the item to teleport instantly to Divinity's Reach.

[h1]Activities[/h1]
[h2]Celestial Challenge[/h2]
Speak to the Celestial Challenge Attendant at the Crown Pavilion in Divinity's Reach to begin the Celestial Challenge, a series of activities that will require you to take down enemies, race through checkpoints, perform feats of jumping mastery, and more. The more activities you successfully complete during the event, the greater your rewards at the end.

[h2]Dragon Ball Arena[/h2]
Speak to Finola at the Crown Pavilion in Divinity's Reach to enter the Dragon Ball Arena. This dodgeball-like PvP game mode is a race to the finish, with the first team of five players to reach five hundred points claiming victory. Collect power-ups throughout the arena to gain access to new skills, zip around the arena with zip pads and jump pads, and master the art of the Dragon Sphere.

[h2]Mount Racing[/h2]
Race around Divinity's Reach! You don't need to have any mounts unlocked to take place in this race—a nearby rental service is available to rent a raptor for just 10 silver.

[h2]Firecracker Lighting[/h2]
Speak to the firecracker-lighting NPC at the Crown Pavilion in Divinity's Reach to start this seasonal adventure. Use your mastery of the world to quickly navigate through the streets of Divinity's Reach and light all the firecrackers! Gliding, mounts, anything goes—just don't use any waypoints, or your progress will be reset!

notes.title: Guild Wars 2 Minimum System Requirements Update
notes.notes:
Hello, all,

As many of you know, we have been working on implementing and improving support for DirectX 11 in [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]. Completing this upgrade will allow us to utilize more modern rendering features, improving both the graphical fidelity and performance of [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]. We're happy to announce that we are now ready to remove the DirectX 9 renderer for [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] and migrate all players to the DirectX 11 renderer.

With this upgrade, we'll begin adjusting our minimum system requirements to include a DirectX 11-compatible GPU on February 6. This upgrade will roll out to all players over an eight-week period. We expect the process to be completed and all players to be migrated to the DirectX 11 client by April 18.

After the rollout has been completed, you will no longer be able to launch the game with DirectX 9. Players with systems that are not compatible with DirectX 11 will need to either upgrade their hardware to include a DirectX 11-compatible GPU or use a cloud gaming service such as NVIDIA GeForce NOW to continue playing [i]Guild Wars 2[/i].

DirectX 11 was originally released in 2009, and nearly any GPU released since then should support it. However, if you'd like to double-check your system for compatibility, doing so is simple:
[olist][*]In Windows, select Start and enter "dxdiag" into the search box on the taskbar.[/*]
[*]Then, select dxdiag from the results.[/*]
[*]Once the tool has opened, navigate to the "Display 1" section.[/*]
[*]On the right side of this panel, under the "Drivers" section, check the "Feature Levels" listed for your display. [/*]
[*]If your "Feature Levels" list contains "11_0" or higher, your GPU is DirectX 11-compatible.[/*][/olist]

Thank you,
—The [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] Team

notes.title: Studio Update: Happy Wintersday from the Guild Wars 2 Team
notes.notes:
Before we head out for our annual holiday break and bid farewell to 2022, we want to take a few moments to celebrate the past year and extend our heartfelt gratitude to you, our players, for making it all possible.

2022 was a fantastic year for [i]Guild Wars 2[/i], and it started off with a bang. On February 28, we released our third expansion, [i]Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons™[/i], which brought a climactic end to the elder dragon saga (spoiler!). The team poured their heart and soul into bringing a reimagined Cantha to life, and in the end, we delivered an experience that we're incredibly proud of.

But the expansion is just one part of this year's story. Living World Season 1–which had previously been unplayable for over eight years–returned as a free and permanent addition to the base game. We delivered significant quality-of-life gameplay improvements for both new players and veterans, with more to come. We made considerable progress on long-term initiatives like the DirectX11 upgrade and WvW World Restructuring, and we renewed our focus on regularly refreshing key gameplay systems like combat. And we released [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] on Steam, putting Tyria on the map for an entirely new group of gamers.

We've also reinforced our commitment to being transparent and communicating regularly with all of you, with regular studio updates, quarterly roadmaps, and balance preview livestreams. In the background, we've been working quietly on our next content update, and we began early development on our fourth expansion. In the midst of everything, we celebrated the 10th anniversary of [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]'s original release–an achievement only made possible by the support of our community.

All of this paid off in a big way. Back in April, we reported that our active player count had more than doubled over the past few years and that [i]Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons[/i] had already outsold our previous expansion, [i]Guild Wars 2: Path of Fire™[/i]. Today, we're excited to share a new accomplishment. This year we've already seen more players venture into Tyria for the first time since 2015– the year we made the base game content playable for free and launched our first expansion, [i]Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns™[/i]. This has been one of the best years for [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] in recent memory, and we're eager to keep building on that momentum.

We’ll be back early next year to talk about our Q1 plans, which include wrapping up the DirectX11 transition, continuing work on World vs. World, upgrading our in-game browser technology from Coherent to Chromium Embedded Framework, and of course new [i]Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons[/i] content. We're also looking forward to sharing our long-term vision and plans for the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/bd6d222d4ca43a72b50fa072ba093c7707d6d49a.jpg[/img]

Thank you all for a fantastic 2022. Let's do it again next year.
Have a wonderful Wintersday!
–The [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] Team

notes.title: Wintersday 2022: A Beginner's Guide
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/e590cf5ffaaab7c6d84cc54c008e1ee94f442d71.jpg[/img]

Happy Wintersday, Tyria! Our yearly holiday festival is now live and available until January 3, 2023. You can check out all the details in [url=https://en-forum.guildwars2.com/topic/125500-game-update-notes-december-13-2022/]the full release notes on our official forums[/url]. Read on for a quick rundown of the activities you can take part in during this festival and the rewards you can earn!

This festival is accessible to players of any level. Even if you're brand new to the game, you can easily take part in our Wintersday activities and earn new cosmetic unlocks, utility items, and more!

[h1]Rewards[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/e56e678e7aca31bea8fc097d330e2e6554395d6b.jpg[/img]

Wintersday activities award Wintersday Gifts containing an assortment of holiday treats and surprises. Festival currency includes snowflakes, Snow Diamonds, and karma, which you can exchange for new minis, guild hall decorations, recipes, tonics, and more.

Speak to one of the Charity Corps Seraph at the Crown Pavilion in Divinity's Reach to exchange your snowflakes for Snow Diamonds, and your Snow Diamonds for unique Wintersday rewards.
Many unique rewards—such as the new Wintersday Snow Boots and the Snowdrift weapon set—are obtained by completing achievements. You'll find more information on the Wintersday achievements and their rewards in your Hero panel under the Daily and Festivals categories.

[h1]Where to Go[/h1]
Divinity's Reach is the hub for Wintersday festivities. Check your mail for a letter from Tixx containing an Invitation to Wintersday, which you can use to travel instantly to Divinity's Reach. Portals leading to Divinity's Reach will also be available in Lion's Arch, the Black Citadel, Hoelbrak, Rata Sum, and the Grove.

Visit locations marked by peppermint candies on your map to participate in Wintersday activities. Don't forget to visit Wintersday trees and Toymaker Tixx himself each day to collect gifts.

You'll also receive a letter from Orphan Laine, who needs your help with a scavenger hunt. The hunt will require you to travel to some areas intended for level 80 players, but once you've unlocked it you can complete it at any time, even after Wintersday ends.

For the duration of the festival, massive Mysterious Presents will appear in the open world in Central Tyria maps. They explode when unwrapped, so take care! Fight off hostile skritt and collect the Wintersday Gifts that fall out.

[h1]Activities[/h1]
[h2]Bell Choir Ensemble[/h2]
Speak to the Bell Maestro near the Royal Terrace in Divinity's reach to enter the Enchanted Snow Globe and take part in the bell choir ensemble! In this rhythm game, work together with your fellow Tyrians to reproduce songs from Guild Wars 2 and earn karma, Wintersday Gifts, and more!

[h2]Donation Drive[/h2]
Speak with the Charity Corps Seraph in the Crown Pavilion to purchase Rolls of Wrapping Paper. These rolls can be combined with various items earned from Wintersday activities to create Wrapped Gifts. Give these gifts to orphans throughout Divinity's Reach and get some well-earned karma for your good deeds.

[h2]Mount Racing[/h2]
Race around Divinity's Reach! You don't need to have any mounts unlocked to take place in this race—a nearby rental service is available to rent a raptor for just 10 silver.

[h2]Snowball Mayhem[/h2]
Use a unique set of snow-themed skills to defeat other players in this capture-the-flag-style game mode! Speak with the Festive Lionguard near the Royal Terrace in Divinity's Reach to enter, then choose from three professions: supporter, heavy gunner, or scout. The first team to bring 500 points worth of Wintersday Gifts back to their base wins! 

This content has no level requirement and can be enjoyed by players of all skill levels.

[h2]Strike Mission: Secret Lair of the Snowmen[/h2]
Enter the portal southwest of the Crown Pavilion to take on the legendary Freezie! Form a squad of up to 10 players and mend Freezie's frozen heart. This content is exclusively available to players who have reached level 80.

[h2]Tixx's Infinirarium[/h2]
Enter Toymaker Tixx's airship from the candy cane portal just west of the Crown Pavilion to assist the asuran craftsman in producing enough Wintersday presents for every resident of Tyria.
Take on the haywire machinery and malfunctioning toys throughout the workshop with a party of up to 5 players. This Wintersday-exclusive dungeon is accessible to players of any level and will dynamically adjust your attributes to those of a level 80 player if you are below that level.

[h2]Toypocalypse[/h2]
Defend the gift dolyaks from Tixx's malfunctioning toys! Speak to the Toy Captain just south of the Crown Pavilion in Divinity's Reach to enter this tower-defense-style game mode with a party of up to 5 players. This Wintersday-exclusive activity is accessible to players of any level and will dynamically adjust your attributes to those of a level 80 player if you are below that level.

[h2]Winter Wonderland[/h2]
Jumping puzzle lovers rejoice! Dodge exploding Wintersday gifts and jump across giant melting snowflakes in this holiday-themed jumping puzzle. Speak to the Festive Youth at the Crown Pavilion to enter the Winter Wonderland and take on one of three available paths through the snow, each offering its own difficulty. This content is available to players of any level.

[i]Guild Wars 2[/i] has been updated! Take on a souped-up Watchknight Triumverate in Old Lion's Court Challenge Mode or earn the new Primordus legendary skin variant.

[url=https://en-forum.guildwars2.com/topic/124807-2022-11-29%E2%80%94november-29th-release-notes/]Read the full update notes on our official forums.[/url]

[list][h1]Strike Missions[/h1]
[*]The Challenge Mode for Strike Mission: Old Lion's Court is now available for those looking to face Scarlet's most devious watchknight threat! Players who defeat this challenging encounter can purchase new rewards.[/*]
[*]Fixed an issue that caused defiance bars to unlock sooner than intended during phase transitions in Strike Mission: Old Lion's Court.[/*]
[*]Fixed an issue that sometimes allowed Boiling Aether to be created during phase transitions in Strike Mission: Old Lion's Court.[/*]
[h1]General[/h1]
[*]The Primordus legendary variant skin collection is now available. Speak with Leivas after unlocking an Aurene-based legendary weapon to begin this collection![/*]
[*]Equipped items that you have not selected an attribute combination for will display an alert icon to make them easier to identify. [/*]
[*]Profession icons in player portraits now display a tooltip to identify the player's profession or elite specialization. [/*]
[*]You can now export your custom input bindings to store locally and share them across devices you play on, allowing you to quickly switch bindings by importing them. Exported bindings will be saved in a new folder alongside your screenshots folder. Only currently active bindings are saved to your account. [/*]
[*]An option to randomize your character's appearance and armor colors is now available during character creation. [/*]
[*]An icon has been added to the world map which will display a tooltip with information about how to use your personal waypoint, leave pings, and draw on your map.[/*]
[*]Story Journal Improvements:[/*]
[list][*]A new "View Next in Journal" button has been added to the pop-up notification after completing an episode or story chapter. Pressing it will open the Story Journal to the next available episode or story chapter. The button will display as "Unlock Next" if you have not unlocked that content yet.[/*]
[*]After you complete the final step of any story chapter, episode, or Living World season, your active story will automatically be set to the beginning of the next chapter, episode, or season instead of your next personal story objective.[/*][/list]
[h1]World Polish[/h1]
[*]The existing exotic Primordus weapon set has been renamed to the Destroyer weapon set. Associated achievements and collections have been updated to reflect the new name.[/*]
[*]During  the Living World Season 1 episode "Sky Pirates," the Hard Boiled and Case Closed missions can now be played out of order when replaying the storyline.[/*]
[*]Fixed an issue that allowed players to receive rewards for Group Effort IV and V more than once per completion of the Battle for Lion's Arch meta-event.[/*]

[/list]

[h1]Divine Conqueror Appearance Package[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/eaa1213dcda8dec272f02b77a460f3bf507c2f84.jpg[/img]

What? No, it's just, like, [i]generically[/i] divine. Well, I mean, we can't say Balthazar for…obvious reasons… Look, its regalia fit for a god-king! What more do you want?!

[h1]Chair Functionality Update[/h1]
With the release of [i]Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons™[/i], we added the ability for players to unlock the Arborstone Revitalization Mastery, which allows you to gain a Well Rested bonus when spending time in Arborstone. This effect  provides up to a 25% bonus to all experience gained for up to four hours. However, unlike other bonuses to experience in the game—those obtained through food or utilities, for example—this effect has very specific requirements for how you obtain it or increase its duration.

We'd like to add more ways for players to take advantage of this bonus and make it available  to players who have yet to fully unlock their [i]End of Dragons[/i] Masteries. And what better way to let a weary commander rest and recover than taking a seat on their favorite chair?

With this update, we're adding a new functionality to all chair items. If you're currently affected by the Arborstone Well Rested bonus, sitting in a chair will increase the duration of that effect . Each minute spent sitting in your chair will increase the duration of the Well Rested bonus by eight minutes, up to a total of four hours.

Additionally, even if you do not have access to Arborstone or its Masteries, you can still take advantage of this new functionality. Resting in a chair anywhere in the world will grant you five minutes of the Resting effect. Remaining in the chair until the Resting effect expires will grant you one hour of the A Little Well Rested bonus, granting you 5% bonus experience for its duration.

notes.title: Living World Season 1 Return: "Battle for Lion's Arch" Is Now Live!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=h7aJWxtiFyM;full][/previewyoutube]

The fifth and final episode of Living World Season 1 is now playable for free in your story journal. This chapter brings Season 1 to a close and finally bridges the longstanding gap between the core game and Living World Season 2. The complete saga of [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]—from the original release to End of Dragons™—is now fully playable from start to finish.

This content returns for the first time since its initial release in 2014, along with new and returning rewards and achievements. This episode and all other Season 1 episodes are free, [b]permanent[/b] additions to the base game and are available to all players.

To begin this content, navigate to the story journal in your Hero panel, select "Living World Season 1," then select "5. The Battle for Lion's Arch." Click "Play This Episode," and you will receive a letter from Logan Thackeray requesting your presence at Lornar's Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/9f8deeaed1f2d83bc244cb31141cc8a96ebe01d1.jpg[/img]

The archvillain Scarlet Briar now descends upon Lion's Arch with all her deadly forces. Rally together and defend the besieged city in the new publicly joinable instanced battle, the Battle for Lion's Arch. Join the fight now by speaking to Lionguard Peltgnaw in the Gendarran Fields, just outside the gates of Lion's Arch.

[h1]Rewards[/h1]
[h2]Lion Captain and Lion Champion Gear[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/86cad50778267ee6fe823f8ced90b3714dbaf9bd.jpg[/img]

Complete new achievements to earn new cosmetic rewards: the Lion Captain's Cape, the Lion Captain's Mantle, and the Lion's Champion weapon set.

[h2]Lion's Memory[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/e607b86a57f2a98d4b8d98510d81fb39d54b7f23.jpg[/img]

Completing the Lion's Memory achievement—a meta-achievement that includes content from all of Living World Season 1—will also unlock the Lion's Pride, a permanent teleportation item that will allow you to visit a Lion's Arch that has yet to be visited by Scarlet Briar's destruction.

The funds you raise as a member of Team ArenaNet will contribute to our overall donation total. As in previous years, if we reach the $25,000 USD donation goal, we'll match it to bring the total donation to $50,000!

(It isn't an ArenaNet Extra Life event if we make it through with unscathed heads.) Join them in game or watch the stream on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/guildwars2]our official Twitch channel[/url]. We'll see you there!

Log in to [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] between October 25 and November 15 to receive the title "The Extra Life" if you didn't unlock it in previous years.

notes.title: Shadow of the Mad King 2022
notes.notes:
The spookiest season in Tyria is here and the doorways between our world and the Mad Realm are open... Mad King Thorn (and his horrible sense of humor) walks the streets of Lion’s Arch again! Join fellow Tyrians for special Halloween events and rewards, including new Halloween items for 2022 like new weapon skins, mini pets, gloves, guild hall decorations, and more! 

[previewyoutube=Y9ONwU83GUM;full][/previewyoutube]
Shadow of the Mad King is Guild Wars 2‘s annual Halloween festival that takes place from Oct 18 - Nov 8 and encompasses several events. All players levels 10 and up can participate for free in this seasonal event. In 2021, Shadow of the Mad King was voted the [url=https://www.pcgamer.com/the-best-and-worst-in-game-halloween-events-were-playing-this-year/]#1 In-Game Halloween Event by PC Gamer[/url] - this is an event you won’t want to miss!

Players can earn special Halloween achievements, talk to vendors to exchange special event-specific items and receive rewards like weapons, weapon sets and skins, armor and armor skins, infusions and cosmetic auras, tonics, novelties, guild hall decorations, mini pets, and much more.

[previewyoutube=NiNl8jNpYjg;full][/previewyoutube]
If you’re new to Guild Wars 2, this is the perfect time to grab some friends and breach the Halloween doors in Lion’s Arch. You’ll see an in-game Mail from Magister Tassi with an invitation to the Mad Realm… but Tyrians beware, once you face the Mad King, there’s no telling what frightening thing might happen next!

Want more info on where to go and what to do? Check out our detailed blog [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/news/shadow-of-the-mad-king-2022-live/]here[/url].

notes.title: New Player Guide: Guild Wars 2 Halloween Events
notes.notes:
Greetings, new friends!

Given the recent deluge of brand-new Tyrian citizens, the Captain's Council of Lion's Arch has seen fit to release an informational missive regarding the activities of one Mad King Thorn and his yearly incursion into the streets of Lion's Arch.

[h1]Shadow of the Mad King[/h1]
[previewyoutube=Y9NwxCtXKLw;full][/previewyoutube]
Shadow of the Mad King is [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]'s yearly Halloween-themed festival, and we do holiday events like no other. It's not just a short set of quests or a few cosmetics—it's an entirely new way to play the game. Loads of unique game modes will be available that can be used to expand your wardrobe, fill your wallet, and level up your character faster than ever before.

This content is available [b]for free[/b] to all players. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/605c7659fe6a6565df5dfbd97679ffa9591c0058.png[/img]

For the next three weeks, you'll gain access to a new set of daily and annual achievements that will act as your guide to [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]'s unique set of festival celebrations. Shadow of the Mad King adds a number of activities that can be used to earn our Halloween festival currency, candy corn. It can be spent on new weapon skins, armor skins, miniatures, and more.

[h1]Getting Started[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/21bdcb36258e736fbe164a4925b891346ec3c4ca.png[/img]

First, check your in-game mail for a letter from Magister Tassi containing an Invitation to the Mad Realm. Use this item to travel back and forth between Tyria and the Mad King's Labyrinth.

Lion's Arch is Tyria's Halloween celebration headquarters. Asura gate portals to Lion's Arch are available in major cities and can be used by any player who has purchased a [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] expansion or is at least level 35.

Players without access to Lion's Arch can travel to the Mad Realm from any of [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]'s starting zones:
[list][*] Village of Shaemoor in Queensdale
[*] Village of Smokestead in the Plains of Ashford
[*] Snowlord's Gate in the Wayfarer Foothills
[*] Village of Astorea in Caledon Forest
[*] Soren Draa in Metrica Province[/list]
These locations are outside each starting city's main gate and can be freely teleported to by any character, regardless of which playable race you began the game as. Run to the candy corn icon on your map and speak to a Lunatic Boatmaster guarding a haunted door, and they'll whisk you away to your choice of Halloween activities.

[h1]Activities [/h1]
[h2]The Mad King's Labyrinth[/h2]
How's your inventory management? Clean out your bags and get ready for a loot waterfall.
Squad up and take down the denizens of the labyrinth. Kill stuff, get loot. Open haunted doors around the labyrinth to spawn boss enemies or focus on the small fry while you make a circuit around this haunted maze.

Magic find is an account-wide attribute that increases your chance of receiving high-quality loot from slain enemies. When you're cleansing the Mad King's Labyrinth…you'll be slaying a lot of enemies. Make the most of it by picking up some Heroic Boosters or speak to Madame Cookie within the labyrinth to exchange candy corn for an enhancement to your magic find.

[h2]The Mad King's Clock Tower[/h2]
Hop to the top of a viciously timed jumping puzzle before the deadly miasma below makes its way to you. Open the Magnificent Chest at the top once per day for—you guessed it—more sick loot.

[h2]Mad King Says…[/h2]
Every two hours at the Grand Piazza in Lion's Arch, follow Mad King Thorn's commands and receive key fragments for your efforts. Collect three key fragments and you'll be able to open the Mad King's Chest. This chest is available once per day and will reward you with Trick-or-Treat Bags and some delicious Globs of Ectoplasm.

[h2]Ascent to Madness[/h2]
Group up with up to four friends and take the fight to that despicable Oswald Thorn. He's still up to his Mad King Says antics, too, so keep your ears open for his commands. Defeat the Mad King once per day to earn Trick-or-Treat Bags and more.

[h2]Mad King's Raceway and Labyrinth Race[/h2]
If you haven't tried out [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]'s unique mount system, now's a great chance. Speak with a Lunatic Boatmaster to enter one of the Mad King's many mount races. Even if you don't own a mount, you'll find rental mounts available by speaking to the Mad Stablehand nearby.

[h2]Lunatic Inquisition and Reaper's Rumble[/h2]
If you're more of a PvP-oriented player, we've got something just for you! Take on your fellow Tyrians in the MOBA-style Reaper's Rumble, or escape from the Courtier's grasp in the tag-style Lunatic Inquisition. In the Mad King's Realm, speak to a Lunatic Boatman to enter these game modes. Victory rewards Trick-or-Treat Bags and the greatest reward of all—cold, hard coin.

[h1]Rewards[/h1]
[previewyoutube=NiNl8jNpYjg;full][/previewyoutube]

Once you've tired yourself out with our Halloween festivities, you might find that your constant looting has left you with…well…fewer available bag slots than is ideal. What do you do with all this stuff, anyway?

[h2]Trick-or-Treat Bags[/h2]
The Mad King's mystery bags can contain anything from rare crafting materials to ultra-rare infusions and special weapon skins. Or maybe just some candy corn. Take your chances with opening the bags for the opportunity of a rare drop. Alternatively, sell them to other players on the Trading Post for a guaranteed win.

[h2]Candy Corn[/h2]
Candy corn is as good as coin when Mad King Thorn is in town. One thousand pieces of candy corn can be exchanged for a Candy Corn Cob at candy corn vendors in Lion's Arch or any of the starting zones. You can also feed these candies to a Candy Corn Gobbler for random enhancements to experience, magic find, and more.

The Candy Corn Cobs can be spent at vendors in Lion's Arch for unique weapon skins, armor skins, miniatures, and other rewards. If you're not interested in that, they can also be sold on the Trading Post to other players for a tidy profit.

[h1]Enter The Mad King's Realm Today![/h1]
Clean up your bags and get ready to profit. Level up quicker than ever before. Beat up skeletons. Get loot. Take your friends with you on a journey to the labyrinth and get lost in the joy of exploration.

Play [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] for free now.

See you in the Mad Realm!

notes.title: Shadow of the Mad King 2022 Is Live!
notes.notes:
Ghostly greetings to all! Shadow of the Mad King begins today, and with it three whole fang-tastic weeks of trick-or-treating. New to [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]? Forgotten how to navigate the labyrinth? We've got your spine...err...back! The guide below has everything you need to know.

[h1]Where to Go[/h1]
First, check your in-game mail for a letter from Magister Tassi containing an Invitation to the Mad Realm. Use this item to travel back and forth between Tyria and the Mad King's Labyrinth.
Lion's Arch is Tyria's Halloween celebration headquarters. Asura gate portals to Lion's Arch are available in major cities and can be used by any player who has purchased a [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] expansion or is at least level 35.

Players without access to Lion's Arch can travel to the Mad Realm from the Village of Shaemoor in Queensdale, the Village of Smokestead in the Plains of Ashford, Snowlord's Gate in the Wayfarer Foothills, the Village of Astorea in Caledon Forest, and Soren Draa in Metrica Province. These locations are outside each starting city's main gate. Run to the candy corn icon on your map and speak to a Lunatic Boatmaster guarding a haunted door, and they'll whisk you away to your choice of eerie activities.

Haunted doors will also appear in Kessex Hills and Gendarran Fields throughout the event. Interact with the doors to trick-or-treat!

[h1]What to Do[/h1]
During Halloween, King Oswald Thorn's capricious spirit can manifest in Tyria—and Tyria's citizens can cross into Thorn's Mad Realm.

[h2]Lion's Arch[/h2]
The city of Lion's Arch is transformed with scary decorations and a gloomy autumn glow! Every two hours, Mad King Thorn will gather his "subjects" (anyone within shouting distance) to play a game. Perform the emotes he commands you to—but only if he calls out, "Your Mad King says." If you do well, you'll receive keys to unlock the Mad King's Chest.

The Grand Piazza also features seasonal vendors and doors to Shadow of the Mad King activities.

[h2]The Mad Realm[/h2]
[h3]Mad King's Labyrinth[/h3]
Battle hordes of Halloween creatures, race your mounts, and trick-or-treat at haunted doors through the twists and turns of a macabre maze. It's a great way to gain experience for your characters and Trick-or-Treat Bags full of goodies, especially if you team up with other players to explore. Stay on your toes, though—powerful enemies like the Grand High Viscount of Candy Corn, the legendary Skeletal Lich, and the Labyrinthine Horror will make nougat of the unwary.

[h3]Mad King's Clock Tower[/h3]
Hop to the top of a vicious timed jumping puzzle before the deadly miasma below makes its way to you.

[h3]Ascent to Madness[/h3]
Face Mad King Thorn himself! This dungeon encounter is intended for players of all skill levels and can be entered from Lion's Arch.

[h3]Mad King's Raceway[/h3]
Take your mounts out for a spin in time trials and races against other players. Springer, jackal, and roller beetle rentals are available if you need a steed.

[h3]Minigames[/h3]
Speak to a Lunatic Boatmaster to participate in Reaper's Rumble or Lunatic Inquisition.

[h1]Rewards[/h1]
[previewyoutube=NiNl8jNpYjg;full][/previewyoutube]

Become the spookiest ghoul in the Labyrinth...or die trying. Hahaha-HA! (It's okay, you can just waypoint.) Shadow of the Mad King activities award Trick-or-Treat Bags containing a vast selection of Halloween goods. The primary currency is candy corn, which can be traded to special vendors for minis, armor skins, recipes, and more.

Many unique rewards are obtained by completing achievements. You'll find information on the Shadow of the Mad King achievements and their rewards in your Hero panel under the Daily and Festivals categories.

[h2]New Equipment Skins[/h2]
Weapons heavy with rattling chains, clawed gloves emerging from the darkness—this year, we've got everything. Complete the annual Halloween Rituals achievement to obtain them.
[list][*]Chained Chest (Tier 1)[/*]
[*]Clawing Shadow Gloves Box (Tier 2)[/*][/list]

Clear your way with a terrifyingly beautiful candlestick or become the headless gourmet chef of wild pumpkins. New exotic weapons can be found in the Courtly Weapon Chest or purchased with Candy Corn Cobs from Sparking Stone in Lion's Arch.
[list][*]Nightmare Splitter Axe[/*]
[*]Harvester's Grin Staff[/*]
[*]Pale Light's Companion Torch[/*][/list]

[h2]Candy Corn Exchange[/h2]
What's Halloween without a candy corn extravaganza, right? Use your delicious treats to get new miniatures, traditional Halloween rewards, and more!
[list][*]Mini Fluffy Black Cat[/*]
[*]Mini Black Labrador[/*][/list]

[b]Happy Haunting, Tyrians![/b]

notes.title: Extra Life 2022: Introducing April!
notes.notes:
In three weeks, on November 4, Team ArenaNet will once more be participating in a 24-hour Extra Life Game Day stream! If this is your first time hearing about Extra Life, check out our first blog post about the event [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/en/news/team-arenanet-for-extra-life-2022/]here[/url]!

As a part of our partnership with [url=https://childrensmiraclenetworkhospitals.org/about-us/]Children's Miracle Network Hospitals[/url], we're doing something extremely special this year: we'll be adding a [url=https://childrensmiraclenetworkhospitals.org/the-children/]CMN Champion child[/url], April Arellano, as a nonplayable character in [i]Guild Wars 2[/i].

[h1]Meet April![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/2b96ec25a10a5f6649d39c01845ad473e6e6f4ba.jpg[/img]

At fifteen months old, April Arellano was sick and struggling to breathe, struck with a 105-degree fever. Her parents, Antonio and Shannon, brought her to a local hospital, where they were able to determine that April had pneumonia in her right lung. However, they were unable to treat her. Her family made a quick decision to transfer her to [url=https://foundation.choc.org/]Children's Health of Orange County (CHOC)[/url], a member hospital of Children's Miracle Network.

Once there, doctors were able to immediately treat April and diagnose her with septic shock. Septic shock is fatal in 98% of cases involving children, but thanks to the specialists at CHOC, April was quickly diagnosed and treated, saving her life.

Further tests showed that the septic shock April was suffering from had stopped the blood flow to her extremities, causing the skin there to die all the way down to the muscle. April was transferred to the burn unit at a neighboring hospital where they determined that gangrene had already begun to set in on April's right calf. The doctors made the decision to amputate April's leg to stop any further infection—once again saving her life.

April is ten years old now, and she loves to sing, dance, perform in local theater, and play video games. Her parents attribute her current good health to the support provided by CHOC and Children's Miracle Network Hospitals.

[h1]Meet April, the Mesmer Wunderkind![/h1]
[previewyoutube=xzIIUCTUpNM;full][/previewyoutube]

April was born and raised just outside of Divinity's Reach, in the small village of Garenhoff. She's an ambitious and adept mesmer—and a serial meddler. We spent a lot of time working together with the real April and her parents to nail down aspects of her design, and we're extremely proud of the result! April will be appearing in [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] as an important part of a special game update that will go live during our Extra Life 2022 Game Day event.

This event is an important part of our Extra Life plans for this year, so we're keeping most of the details under wraps for now. We want the maximum impact possible on Game Day to help change kids' health! Make sure to tune in to our Extra Life Game Day stream on November 4 for more information on how you can access this new content and meet April yourself.

A quick word from our development team on the upcoming content:

"Hey, all, Indigo Boock here! I'm a narrative designer working on [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]. We're so excited for everyone to dig into April's little adventure during our Extra Life Game Day. I don't want to reveal too many secrets just yet, but I can say that getting to talk with April Lynn and learn about her story was such a delight. I was immediately inspired by her confidence (and her dance moves, of course). April's character in-game is resilient, brave, and filled with charm—but she barely compares to her namesake. We can't wait for you to witness our little mesmer's shenanigans firsthand."

notes.title: Team ArenaNet for Extra Life 2022
notes.notes:
For the sixth year in a row, Team ArenaNet will be supporting Extra Life!

[h1]What is Extra Life?[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/0c08ce3183ed1fe749c2c413e0bbe746e96e74c6.png[/img]

During the annual Extra Life marathon, teams and individuals from many gaming communities stream games for twenty-four hours to raise funds in support of [url=https://childrensmiraclenetworkhospitals.org/]Children's Miracle Network[/url], a network of 170 nonprofit children's hospitals throughout the United States and Canada. Donations pay healthcare costs for critically ill and injured children not covered by health insurance or Medicaid, help hospitals purchase pediatric medical equipment, and fund disease research. Children's Miracle Network Hospitals provide 32 million treatments to children every year thanks to events like Extra Life .

Since 2017, Team ArenaNet has raised over $500,000 in donations for Children's Miracle Network hospitals. Our global community of players has come together each year to support this mission, and we're calling on you all to help us break our fundraising record once again!

During Extra Life 2021, you helped us raise over $100,000 in a single day. This year, we're aiming even higher. Our goal is to raise $125,000 by the end of our Game Day livestream, and we need help from the legendary heroes of Tyria to make it happen.

This year, during our 24-hour Game Day stream, we have a variety of exciting in-game and out-of-game events planned. Additionally, we'll be running our second Twitch Drops campaign during the Extra Life Game Day event. We'll reveal some details about these in the coming weeks, so keep your eyes peeled for more updates from us soon!

[h1]Join Team ArenaNet[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/590f2e8c82c395897e9b09a583dbcde878ff81d0.jpg[/img]

We're all working toward the same goal for Extra Life: helping kids! Everyone is invited to be part of Team ArenaNet. To join, visit the [url=https://www.extra-life.org/]official Extra Life website[/url] and choose "Team ArenaNet" as your team when you sign up.

If you'd like to create your own team, we invite you to join the [url=https://www.extra-life.org/arenanet]ArenaNet Super Team[/url]. When you sign up on the official Extra Life website, choose "Create a Sub Team." Your team will still have its own page, members, and fundraising goals, but you'll be recognized on the ArenaNet Super Team's leaderboards and the funds you raise will contribute to the overall Super Team total.

Once you join Team ArenaNet, all donations will contribute to our overall donation total. As in previous years, once we hit the $25,000 goal we'll match that donation to bring the total to $50,000.

You don't have to livestream [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] to team up with us. You can stream a game of your choice, or raise funds by telling your friends, family, and colleagues how they can donate to support Extra Life.

[h1]Game Day: November 4[/h1]
The ArenaNet team members are excited to kick off this year's 24-hour streaming marathon. Our Extra Life Game Day event begins at 12:00 PM Pacific Time on Friday, November 4 and ends at 12:00 PM on Saturday, November 5.

You can watch the stream on our [url=http://www.twitch.tv/guildwars2/]official Twitch channel[/url]. Stay tuned for more information on the fun we have planned—and visit the [url=https://www.extra-life.org/arenanet]Team ArenaNet page[/url] to sign up or donate!

notes.notes:

[list][*]Fixed an issue that prevented the Hero panel preview from displaying correctly on high-resolution monitors.

[*]Fixed an issue that prevented some players from entering the Tower of Nightmares encounter in a squad.

[*]Increased the frequency of the Desert Highlands event chain that begins with "Defend Second Spear Nayrim from the Awakened" to make it more accessible for players completing their griffon mount collection.

notes.title: Guild Wars 2 Fall and Winter 2022 Roadmap
notes.notes:
Greetings, [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] community!

Following our previous [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/en/news/guild-wars-2-summer-roadmap-and-july-19-update-preview/]summer roadmap[/url], we'd like to give you a high-level look at our plans for [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] for the remainder of the year.

[h1]Gameplay Systems Updates[/h1]
[h3]October 4 Profession Balance Update [/h3]
Following our [url=https://en-forum.guildwars2.com/topic/121353-october-4-balance-update-preview/]most recent balance update preview[/url], we've taken in some of your feedback and made adjustments to the upcoming competitive-focused October 4 profession balance update. We plan on continuing to offer previews of our profession balance updates and using your valuable feedback to help inform our balance decisions. We'll have the final notes available on the official [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] forums on October 4.

[h3]October 14 WvW World Restructuring Beta 6[/h3]
The sixth beta event for phase one of the WvW World Restructuring feature will take place from October 14 through October 21. The beta event will begin and end with each region's respective weekly World vs World match reset. If you're unfamiliar with this feature or our plans for it, you can learn more about it [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/en/news/studio-update-world-restructuring-and-the-future-of-world-vs-world/]here[/url].

During the beta, you'll be able to select one of the new WvW-exclusive War Machine weapon skins for completing an achievement tied to beta participation. We'll also be bringing back the Call of War special event. Earn increased WvW rewards including double WvW experience, increased WvW reward track progress, and a bonus to magic find while in WvW.

The World Restructuring system allows you to play WvW with a guild of your choice while the beta event is active. The in-game option found in the WvW menu that allows you to select a WvW guild will be available on October 7. You must make your guild selection by 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7) on October 13 or you may be matchmade as an individual for the beta event (i.e., you and your guild will be placed on different teams).

[h3]November 29 Profession Balance Update[/h3]
With our October 4 update, we focused primarily on our competitive game modes. Going forward, we'd like our future profession balance updates to contain changes relevant to all game modes. We plan on having a preview for this update available for public feedback on the official [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] forums a few weeks before the update releases. We'll be following the conversation and adjusting our plans as needed.


[h1]Jormag and Primordus Legendary Variants[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/bfbe34c6f6bdb00bba388094239c5975995954b3.jpg[/img]

Following our previous Aurene-based legendary weapon skin variants, we have two more skin types coming this year inspired by the Elder Dragons Jormag and Primordus. After binding an Aurene-based legendary weapon to your Legendary Armory, visit Leivas at Aurene's Enclave in Seitung Province to unlock the collection The Legendary Facets of Aurene and begin working on acquiring these new skins.

You'll be able to begin unlocking the Jormag legendary skin variants in the October 4 update and the Primordus legendary skin variants in the November 29 update.


[h1]Extra Life[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/01b51d6bacc32d9f3883173d8b1990b8f3ff1b81.jpg[/img]
For the sixth year in a row, Team ArenaNet will be supporting Extra Life! We have a variety of exciting in-game and out-of-game events planned during this year's 24-hour Game Day stream. Join us in supporting Children's Miracle Network on November 4!


[h1]Festivals[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/25e9ea34eeeb929f413986cd17c19684fd198be8.jpg[/img]
The Shadow of the Mad King event returns! Tyria's annual Halloween festivities will be active from October 18 to November 8, and available to all players level 10 and above. A new set of rewards will be added, including brand-new weapons, minis, and guild hall decorations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/2c10d16b65bf7c73beab10527e101b0f91bf31e4.jpg[/img]
Wintersday is fast approaching! The Crown Pavilion in Divinity's Reach will be snowed in once more from December 13 to January 3. Earn new weapon skins and minis while you fight the rogue toys of Tixx's Infinirarium or fight your friends in the "capture the flag"-style Snowball Mayhem!


[h1]Living World Season 1 Return: Battle for Lion's Arch[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/8dd16c15b9af23200869c64e5e69c76de92f0fe8.jpg[/img]

The fifth and final episode of Living World Season 1, "Battle for Lion's Arch," will return to [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] on November 8. This will be a permanent addition to the game, free to all players. With the release of "Battle for Lion's Arch," we'll also be adding a new Strike Mission to the game: Old Lion's Court.

For players looking for a greater challenge, a challenge mode version of Old Lion's Court will be released with our November 29 update.


[h1]Fall/Winter Roadmap[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/8175542226a5d9038fdf645d9b9d8b651df31440.jpg[/img]

notes.notes:

Celebrate [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]'s tenth anniversary and the launch of [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] on Steam with our first Twitch Drops campaign! From August 23 at 12 p.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7) to August 28 at 11:59 p.m. (UTC-7), you can earn in-game rewards for watching any Twitch channel broadcasting [i]Guild Wars 2[/i].

[b]How to Participate[/b]
You simply need to link your Twitch account with your [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] account, log in to Twitch, and watch any [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] broadcast with the "Drops Enabled" tag while the campaign is active.

[b]Account Linking Instructions[/b]
[list=1]
  [*]Log in to the [url=https://account.arena.net/]ArenaNet Account Management Site[/url] and navigate to the "Applications" tab.
  [*]In the "Account Linking" section, click "Connect" next to Twitch.
  [*]Follow the prompts to connect your [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] and Twitch accounts*.
  [*]You're ready to watch!
[/list]
Once you've linked accounts and met the watch-time goal for a reward, you'll need to claim the reward on Twitch before it will be delivered to you in-game. You'll get a notification in Twitch chat to claim it after you've met a goal, or you can claim your rewards from your [url=https://www.twitch.tv/drops/inventory]Drops Inventory[/url] on Twitch. Once you claim the reward on Twitch, it will be delivered to your in-game mail within an hour. You can learn more about Twitch Drops on [url=https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/mission-based-drops?language=en_US]Twitch's help[/url] site.

[i]*Note: Only one Twitch account can be associated with a [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] account for each Twitch Drops campaign.[/i]

[i]**Participants in our 10th Anniversary Twitch Drops event are intended to receive 2 Heroic Boosters after watching an eligible Guild Wars 2 Twitch livestream for 30 minutes. Due to a bug players are only receiving a single Heroic Booster.

To address this, after the Twitch Drops event has concluded we’ll be sending any player that completed the Heroic Booster watch time requirement two additional boosters via in-game mail for a total of three boosters.

Thank you for your patience while we fix this![/i]

notes.title: Happy 10th Anniversary, Guild Wars 2 Community!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/ce0b573e31d0e8e149672d23fb245ad4eb2efd9e.jpg[/img]

The 10th anniversary of [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] is here! It's time to celebrate our incredible community and a decade of adventures in Tyria, so let's jump in to see what's in store.

[h3]Guild Wars 2 10th Anniversary Event[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/c260842d8b568c07e033f76223e7f8cdc3a9768d.jpg[/img]

When you log in today, you'll find a new series of achievements waiting for you that will take you on a journey to experience the best of [i]Guild Wars 2[/i], [i]Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns[/i], [i]Guild Wars 2: Path of Fire[/i], [i]Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons[/i], world bosses, Living World, World vs. World, Player vs. Player, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/fc046267065ce1f02f4cde2de4954aaf671ad9dd.jpg[/img]

As you complete these tasks you'll earn Proofs of Legend, which can be traded in for the new Decade's armor set. Characters who are turning ten themselves will also receive an extra Proof of Legend to kickstart their collection. Speak to an ancient armorsmith in one of the capital cities or Lion's Arch to trade in your Proofs of Legend and collect your rewards. Complete enough achievements and you'll also unlock the Decade's War cape skin and your choice of a weapon from the new Dragon Decade set.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/9f7128a0307e9a030014b8019ee37e13d1104e4e.jpg[/img]

These achievements are permanent additions to the game for all current and future players.

[h3]Life Is Better with Friends[/h3]

Log in and check the Gem Store today to get a free Life with Friends Box, containing five Teleport to Friend tokens and one Revive Orb. And don't forget to log in later this week to claim a free Communal Boost Bonfire. We'll have additional Gem Store giveaways running through the end of August.

To welcome our friends joining us from Steam, we are also offering the following bundles for new players to jump-start their new adventures in Tyria. These are available for purchase by all:

[list]
[*][b]Steam Welcome Pack:[/b] Two Bag Slot Expansions, two 20 Slot Black Lion Satchels, five Experience Boosters, five Account-Bound Unidentified Dyes, and ten Merchant Expresses[/*]
[*][b]Steam Elite Jump-Start Pack[/b]: Copper-Fed Salvage-o-Matic, Shared Inventory Slot, Unbreakable Gathering Tools Container, Character Slot Expansion, and Royal Terrace Pass[/*]
[/list]
[h3]Steam Is Live[/h3]

[previewyoutube=P0x1qgygPto;full][youtube_inline id=P0x1qgygPto][/previewyoutube]

With the release of [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] on Steam, a whole new group of players are joining us on our adventures. Our wonderful [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] community has always gone to heroic lengths to welcome new players to Tyria, and we encourage everyone to offer new commanders a friendly helping hand.

Steam players can experience the entire base [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] game for free! You can upgrade your account with expansions at any time to remove [url=https://help.guildwars2.com/hc/en-us/articles/115015898508]the restrictions placed on free accounts[/url].

Reminder: existing [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]accounts can't be linked to Steam and vice versa. [url=https://help.guildwars2.com/hc/en-us/articles/360053416353-Steam-FAQ]Please visit our knowledge base for more info[/url].

[h3]Twitch Drops[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/f333fbca4b65daa1b84e69bc3a4cf4bac91ee1c1.jpg[/img]

Celebrate [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]'s 10th anniversary and the launch of [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] on Steam with our first Twitch Drops campaign!

Link your Twitch and [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] accounts and earn rewards for watching any Twitch channel broadcasting [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]! Tune in to any Twitch livestream with Twitch Drops enabled between August 23 at noon Pacific Time (UTC-7) and August 28 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7) to earn Transmutation Charges, boosters, a mini, a Total Makeover Kit, a Glowing Purple Mask, and your choice of a classic [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] character outfit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/b4f9761e8c206d3298a5e6bf2b6c856ecc321458.png[/img]

For more details about Twitch Drops, visit [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/en/news/twitch-drops]this blog post[/url].

Members of the ArenaNet Partner Program will be streaming a wide variety of content during the Steam release week and tenth anniversary (and beyond) to showcase all aspects of Guild Wars 2: story content, raids, Strike Missions, fractals, Player vs. Player, World vs. World, and more. There will be something for everyone.

If you're looking for an exciting broadcast to check out while you collect your loot, tune in to the livestream on the [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/guildwars2]Twitch channel[/url] on Saturday, August 27 at noon Pacific Time (UTC-7) for the August monthly PvP tournament finals. [url=https://twitch.tv/MightyTeapot]MightyTeapot[/url] will be shoutcasting the tournament along with ArenaNet Game Designer Roy Marks.

Join us as we support our content creator community on Twitch and welcome a new generation of players!

[h3]Seattle Community Event[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/94df4aae3b71c608fd18c921baffdcf59ae39411.jpg[/img]

Celebrate with us at our upcoming community event in and Seattle, Washington. For more details, check out the [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/en/news/celebrate-guild-wars-2s-10th-anniversary-in-cologne-and-seattle/]blog post[/url].

[h3]Crucial Sweepstakes[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/e3824e20c3424646c9660a6be518b0b97919bbe3.jpg[/img]

Our friends at Crucial will be hosting a sweepstakes to celebrate the 10th anniversary with the community!

Fans have a chance to win ten amazing prizes from Crucial, including a 32GB Crucial DDR5 RAM Kit, 1TB Crucial X8, 1TB Crucial P5 Plus NVMe SSD, and Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons Standard Edition.

For more details and to enter, please visit [url=https://gleam.io/jtmeI/guild-wars-2-10th-anniversary-celebration-with-crucial]this link[/url].

[h3]Ten Years Young[/h3]

Thank you for making Tyria your home, and we look forward to many more years of fun and adventures with you!

Happy anniversary,
—The [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] Team

notes.title: Game Update Notes: August 23, 2022
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/0cd911c29510f0cc86f1b03d6f93ff92d48d4b34.png[/img]

Ten years ago, the launch of [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] opened a new window into the world of Tyria. Three expansions, five seasons of Living World releases, and countless updates later, we're still inspired by the dedication of the game's fans.

To commemorate this anniversary for new and veteran players alike, we've added a series of new achievements taking you across the game to earn Proofs of Legend, which you can trade for the new Decade's armor set. If you're busy this week, no need to worry—these achievements and the armor set will be available permanently. Characters who are turning ten themselves will also be receiving an extra Proof of Legend to kickstart their collection. If you have extras, you can trade them for some treats to share with your friends.

It's an honor to share this world with you. Thanks for playing, and here's to many more years of adventuring in Tyria!

Read the complete release notes on the [url=https://en-forum.guildwars2.com/topic/120020-game-update-notes-august-23-2022/]official forums[/url].

notes.title: Studio Update: Guild Wars 2 Tenth Anniversary and Steam Launch on August 23
notes.notes:
Hello, [i]Guild Wars [/i] community!

ArenaNet was founded over twenty years ago with a simple yet ambitious mission: challenge conventions in the MMO genre and usher in a new era of online role-playing games. This mission led us to create of the world of Tyria, a place we first explored together in [i]Guild Wars: Prophecies®[/i] in 2005. It was [i]different[/i], and our players knew it, too. Who ever heard of a successful online role-playing game without a subscription fee? Well, the idea caught on, and its success allowed us to double down with a sequel: [i]Guild Wars 2[/i].

[i]Guild Wars 2[/i] launched on August 28, 2012, and since then, over sixteen million players from across the globe have stepped into Tyria. Later this month, we'll reach an incredible milestone by celebrating the tenth anniversary of the [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] launch. Together, we've embarked on epic adventures, forged lifelong friendships and rivalries, created countless memories, and defeated a few dragons in the process, too. Ten years is a remarkable achievement for an online game, especially when you consider that many don't make it through the first. We continue to be thankful to you, our community—we're here today because of your support and trust.

We took an innovative, player-first approach to [i]Guild Wars 2[/i], challenging conventions in the same spirit as the original [i]Guild Wars [/i]. We created an immersive world that focuses on fun rather than endless gear grind—a game that respects your time and never invalidates your hard work, where you're always happy to see another player. We did it without charging a subscription fee or introducing pay-to-win monetization. We took risks, and we continue to take them.

Unfortunately, many of the player frustrations that we observed in the industry during [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]'s early development are still prevalent today. At ArenaNet, we're gamers just as much as we're game developers, and that's why it's important to us that we continue to stand by our values and our players even when it proves to be a more difficult path. We want to build the kinds of games that we want to play. Thankfully, we know there are a lot of gamers out there that feel just like we do. We're celebrating the tenth anniversary of [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] by reaffirming our commitment to being different, honoring our community, and introducing the world of Tyria to an entirely new group of players who are also looking for something different.

[h3]Steam Rises[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/e4c4637656f0d72d6afcccd21eee4ac2f2009f2a.jpg[/img]

It's time to tell your friends to update their Steam wishlists—we're pleased to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1284210/Guild_Wars_2/][i]Guild Wars 2[/i] will launch on Steam[/url] on August 23 at noon Pacific Time (UTC-7)! This is something we've wanted to do for a long time, and the tenth anniversary felt like the perfect moment to make it happen.

Steam players will be able to experience the core [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] game for free (with the [url=https://help.guildwars2.com/hc/en-us/articles/115015898508]same restrictions applied to free accounts[/url] created on GuildWars2.com), with options to upgrade to [i]Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns™[/i], [i]Guild Wars 2: Path of Fire™[/i], and [i]Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons™[/i] from day one. We've heard your feedback that Living World unlocks should be better communicated to prospective players, so we'll also be creating a Complete Collection bundle that includes [i]Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns[/i], [i]Guild Wars 2: Path of Fire[/i], [i]Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons[/i], and Living World Seasons 2 through 5 (Living World Season 1 is free for everyone).

The Complete Collection won't be immediately available to players outside of Steam, but we'll be working to add it to our web store and the in-game store for players with accounts created via GuildWars2.com in the near future. (Note: Existing [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] accounts can't be linked to Steam and vice versa. [url=https://help.guildwars2.com/hc/en-us/articles/360053416353-Steam-FAQ]Please visit our knowledge base for more info[/url].) Additionally, we'll be making it clear on our Steam page that Living World seasons must be purchased separately from expansions. No surprises.

We want to make the most of the Steam launch, so over the past few months we've been working on improvements to the new player experience. We've improved leveling pacing, updated default options and key binds to be more sensible, added multiple tiers of new achievements that guide players up through level 80, added a free trial for the raptor mount once players reach level 10 (which becomes a permanent unlock after purchasing an expansion), adjusted level-up rewards and Black Lion Instant Level 80 Tickets, updated early game content like world bosses with revised mechanics and tutorials, streamlined dungeon currencies and increased their rewards, made it easier to get into raid content, added accessibility options, improved the player experience in story instances, revamped fractal instabilities, improved raid and Strike Mission rewards and currencies, removed tedious mechanics like equipment repairing, fixed some long-standing content bugs, and implemented DirectX 11 to improve game performance. We also released the first three episodes of Living World Season 1, which gives new players a better understanding of the story as they head into later content. The fourth episode will drop on September 13.

We're happy to report that our metrics show that these changes have made a significant impact, and we'll continue to make additional improvements in the coming months as we monitor the Steam launch. We'll see a steady stream of new players coming into the game from Steam moving forward, so even changes that come after launch will be beneficial. Overall, we're feeling pretty good about the balance we struck between investing in the new player experience and making progress toward developing future content for our veteran players.

We're incredibly excited about the upcoming Steam launch, and we hope you'll join us in shouting it from the rooftops—tell your friends, family, neighbors, and of course your gamer pals! This is the perfect time to join the Guild Wars community.

[h3][i]Guild Wars 2[/i] 10th Anniversary Event[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/fc046267065ce1f02f4cde2de4954aaf671ad9dd.jpg[/img]

It wouldn't be a true celebration if we didn't show some love to the community that's supported us all these years. When you log in on August 23, you'll find a new series of achievements waiting for you that will take you on a journey to experience the best of [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]: world bosses, [i]Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns[/i], [i]Guild Wars 2: Path of Fire[/i], [i]Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons[/i], Living World, World vs. World, Player vs. Player, and more. As you complete these tasks, you'll earn Proofs of Legend, which can be traded in for the new Decade armor set.

These achievements are permanent additions to the game, so our new friends joining us from Steam will be able to make progress on these achievements as they explore Tyria at their own pace.

A +30% bonus to karma, magic find, and PvP and WvW reward-track progress will be active for one week starting on August 23.

As is traditional, we'll also have a wide range of Gem Store sales to celebrate the anniversary, and maybe even a few freebies to collect (spoiler: mount skin).

[h3]Twitch Drops[/h3]

Soon you'll be able to link your Twitch and [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] accounts and earn rewards for watching any Twitch channel broadcasting [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] on Twitch! Tune in to any Twitch livestream with Twitch Drops enabled between August 23 at noon Pacific Time (UTC-7) and August 28 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7) to earn Transmutation Charges, boosters, a mini, a Glowing Purple Mask, and your choice of a classic Guild Wars 2 character outfit.

Members of the ArenaNet Partner Program will be streaming a wide variety of content during the Steam release week and tenth anniversary (and beyond) to showcase all facets of [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]: story content, raids, Strike Missions, fractals, Player vs. Player, World vs. World, and more. There will be something for everyone.

Stay tuned for more information on how to participate!

[h3]A Call to Arms[/h3]

When [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] launches on Steam on August 23, we'll have a wave of new players entering Tyria for the very first time, and those players will be looking for new friends and communities to call home. We hope our veteran players will join us in welcoming these new players into our world with open arms. We're stronger together!

Beyond the tenth anniversary and Steam launch, there's so much on the horizon that we're excited about. Some of the big items are:
[list]
    [*]The final two episodes of Living World Season 1 Return (plus a new Strike Mission and challenge mode).[/*]
    [*]A new location and story to experience in Cantha.[/*]
    [*]World vs. World updates, including World Restructuring and Alliances. [/*][/list]
Not to mention that our next expansion is in early development! There's never been a better time to be a [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] player.

Happy anniversary,

—The [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] Team

notes.title: 9-year-old Guild Wars 2 getting DirectX11 support to "help the game continue to look beautiful"
notes.notes:
Guild Wars 2 is getting DirectX11 support soon, developer ArenaNet has said.

In a post on the Guild Wars 2 website, senior engine programmer James Fulop said a beta for the DirectX11 support goes live on 21st September.

Guild Wars 2, which launched in 2012, currently supports DirectX9.

Read more

notes.title: Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons expansion out February 2022
notes.notes:
Guild Wars 2's End of Dragons expansion comes out out February 2022, developer ArenaNet has announced.

End of Dragons is the third expansion for the long-running fantasy MMORPG. The new trailer is below:

End of Dragons is set on the lost land of Cantha, a "multi-ethnic land of magic that is home to the oldest nation of humans in all of Tyria", ArenaNet said. This area was first seen in 2006's Guild Wars Factions, but has been closed off in Guild Wars 2.

Read more

notes.title: Guild Wars 2 expansion End of Dragons delayed, but senior devs return to ArenaNet
notes.notes:
Guild Wars 2 developer ArenaNet has issued an update on the studio and its long-running MMO.

The headline announcement is the End of Dragons expansion has been delayed from late 2021 to early 2022. In a post on the Guild Wars 2 website, ArenaNet director John Taylor explained the delay:

"As expansion development has progressed and the real-world challenges of the past year and a half have changed the way we live and work, it's become clear that we need a little more time to deliver our creative vision for Cantha. As a result, we're delaying the release of Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons from late 2021 to early 2022.

Read more

notes.title: Guild Wars 2's move to Steam has been indefinitely delayed
notes.notes:
ArenaNet has confirmed its MMO Guild Wars 2's release on Steam has been indefinitely delayed.

ArenaNet first revealed Guild Wars 2 would be making its way to Steam back in August. Originally scheduled for release in November, the plan was to release alongside its Heart of Thorns and Path of Fire expansions.

Now, however, the Steam release has been "put on hold for the time being", with no revised release window detailed.

Read more

notes.title: Eight years after its original launch, Guild Wars 2 is heading to Steam
notes.notes:
Developer ArenaNet's free-to-play MMO Guild Wars 2 will be making its way to Steam - alongside its Heart of Thorns and Path of Fire expansions, plus all Living World Content - this November, over eight years after the game's original release.

It's just one of several initiatives ArenaNet has announced to mark Guild Wars 2's eighth birthday, with others including a new unlockable ability for Path of Fire's Skimmer mounts, enabling players to dive them underwater, as well as 50% off Path of Fire until 4th September.

The big reveal, however, comes in a the form of a new teaser trailer for Guild Wars 2's third expansion, End of Dragons, which is currently scheduled to launch next year.

Read more
